Definition: from G804; to render secure:--make fast (sure).
BiblicalUsage: To make fast is to lock down, and men used this word twice against Christ. The chief priests asked Pilate to make the tomb secure, the stone was sealed and the watch set, and the jailer at Philippi thrust Paul and Silas into the inner prison and made their feet fast in the stocks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every lock men set failed in the same way, because no seal can hold the One who is life itself. The tomb was made as sure as men could make it, and it stood empty by morning.
